heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 98–573, title VI, § 622(a)(1), Oct. 30, 1984, 98 Stat. 3039

notes.text: Section, act June 17, 1930, ch. 497, title VII, § 740, as added July 26, 1979, Pub. L. 96–39, title I, § 101, 93 Stat. 175, provided that the antidumping duty imposed by section 1673 of this title was to be treated as a normal customs duty for drawback purposes. See section 1677h of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Section repealed effective Oct. 30, 1984, see section 626(a) of Pub. L. 98–573, set out as an Effective Date of 1984 Amendment note under section 1671 of this title.
